# PILEPIT (پلەپیت)

> A Kurdish Sorani word-puzzle game being prepared for Android and iOS.

## Official information
- Website: https://pelepit.com/
- Language: Kurdish Sorani (ckb), right-to-left.
- Gameplay: connect letters to discover words and complete puzzle stages.
- Features shown: campaign map and two-player mode.
- Availability: coming soon; no download links or release date have been announced.

This site is in pre-launch. Search indexing is disabled. This file is descriptive metadata, not permission to bypass crawler restrictions or a guarantee of AI inclusion.
